title: Kymaean Alpha Character Anchor & Component Anatomy 01

authority.engineer_2_status: working independently; no Engineering mutation or coordination interruption

source_authority: APPUI Phase 3 Static App Visual System Reference 01
APPUI Component System — Foundational Control Grammar 01
thesis: A Stage Character is a place in the shared room, not a card. The cone carries atmospheric presence; the floor/name hinge carries explicit identity and creator interaction; creator chrome stays outside fiction.

anatomy.A0: Semantic target region — generous but visually hidden interaction/accessibility target.
anatomy.A1: Cone presence — atmospheric Character volume; never a hard UI container.
anatomy.A2: Floor contact/pool — Stage contact and preferred local modulation/interaction region.
anatomy.A3: Identity line — human-readable Character name as primary explicit identity.
anatomy.A4: State witness line — compact explicit supported Stage state where applicable.
anatomy.A5: Keyboard focus witness — transient structural focus at floor/name semantic target.
anatomy.A6: Creator selection witness — persistent structural selection at floor/name hinge.
anatomy.A7: Contextual-action attachment — application-side actions adjacent to anchor, outside cone.
anatomy.A8: Relationship/shared-field witness — ensemble-level only; not permanent Character metadata.

invariants: semantic target bounds remain visually hidden
cone never becomes a selectable card/container
floor pool is not a meter/score/progress control
state witness remains subordinate to name and explicit when needed
focus and selection remain independent and may coexist
creator actions remain outside fictional carrier
same anatomy survives White and Black application themes
same anatomy survives sparse and dense Stage arrangements

sparse: do not inflate anchors into portrait monuments/cards
do not add metadata just because room exists
retain relational rather than mechanical centering
dense: do not fall back to boxed columns or equal dashboard tiles
2-5 remains design-stress evidence only, not Product cardinality

prohibited: relationship metadata permanently attached to anchors
dense-layout fallback to equal dashboard tiles

drive.document_title: Kymaean Alpha Character Anchor & Component Anatomy 01

contradictions_found_and_resolved: Older rectangular/boxed selection concepts remain superseded by floor/name-local focus/selection.
Density evidence is retained as carrier stress only and cannot become a Product cardinality rule.
Component-system focus/selection mechanics are reused semantically without turning the Stage carrier into a generic app component.
Contextual creator actions are kept adjacent/outside the cone so creator authority does not masquerade as fictional Character action.
